title: CISA KEV +10: Mitel MiCollab, Juniper Session Smart, Vates Xen Orchestra, Danfoss AK-SM 800A
sum: CISA added 10 actively-exploited CVEs to KEV on Nov 25: Mitel MiCollab (5 CVEs exploited as zero-days pre-patch, suspected AI-assisted), Juniper Session Smart Conductor CVE-2026-103406 (CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated root RCE via Salt minion ID), Vates Xen Orchestra CVE-2026-133469 (unauthenticated auth bypass), and Danfoss AK-SM 800A (3 CVEs in ICS refrigeration controllers). MiCollab attackers reached root in 30 minutes and pivoted to Active Directory; BOD 26-04 sets Jan 1 deadlines for most.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — patch Mitel/Juniper/Vates/Danfoss before the Jan 1 deadline
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — confirm no exposed vulnerable versions
M1030 Network Segmentation — isolate Danfoss ICS controllers from IT

title: Drupal installer patch gap (CVE-2026-136716) — access bypass exploited in wild
sum: A Nov 18 patch for the Drupal installer flaw CVE-2026-132165 left some sites vulnerable; a new access-bypass bug allows site takeover on production sites and is actively exploited in the wild. Fixed in 11.4.14, 11.3.23 and 10.6.23 and requires a database update hook.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — patch Drupal to 11.4.14/11.3.23/10.6.23
M1042 Disable or Remove Feature or Program — block the installer post-provisioning
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — sweep for exposed Drupal installs

title: GeoServer 5-CVE RCE chain — actively exploited, public exploit code
sum: Five CVEs (CVE-2026-120705, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245, CVE-2026-129242, CVE-2026-129244) chain for unauthenticated remote code execution in GeoServer, actively exploited with public exploit code available. Patched in GeoServer 3.0.2, 2.28.6 and 2.27.7.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — patch to 3.0.2/2.28.6/2.27.7
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — locate exposed GeoServer instances
M1037 Filter Network Traffic — restrict access to admin endpoints

title: SAP confirms 'Project Granite' — GitHub tokens stolen, source code copied and altered
sum: SAP confirmed Nov 27 that attackers stole employee GitHub authentication tokens and used them to copy and alter source code in SAP's GitHub environment; no evidence of customer data impact, but compromised source could seed future supply-chain attacks. SAP rotated signing keys, restricted GitHub access and suspended automated dev ops.
ctl: M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — enforce phishing-resistant MFA on developer accounts
M1018 User Account Management — rotate compromised tokens
M1045 Code Signing — verify integrity of SAP code artifacts

title: 1Password breach — employee GitHub account used to push malicious code, customer data stolen
sum: An employee GitHub account compromised Nov 19 was used to push malicious code to backend services; customer names, emails, account IDs, public keys, SRP parameters and invitation/recovery tokens were stolen. Vaults and encryption keys were not accessed.
ctl: M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — enforce on GitHub accounts
M1026 Privileged Account Management — scope developer access
M1047 Audit — monitor backend services for anomalous pushes

title: Hex (Elixir/Erlang) package manager breached via CVSS 10 deserialization RCE
sum: Attackers exploited CVE-2026-129514 (CVSS 10, unauthenticated deserialization RCE) to execute commands on hex.pm servers; patched within 20 minutes. Email addresses, password/API key hashes and 2FA secrets may be exposed; Ash Framework, db_connection and flop libraries were also patched for related flaws.
ctl: M1027 Password Policies — rotate hex.pm passwords
M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — reset 2FA secrets
M1051 Update Software — apply related library patches

title: US Air Force Cloud One breached amid wider federal breach wave
sum: Hackers breached the Air Force's flagship Cloud One cloud platform, discovered during an upgrade and disrupting application migrations and software updates. Part of a wave hitting CIA unclassified systems, the FBI NCIC database and Treasury FinCEN; the offensive AI tool ARTEX is suspected in some intrusions.
act: CIA / FBI NCIC / Treasury FinCEN systems
ctl: M1026 Privileged Account Management — harden cloud admin access
M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — enforce on government cloud accounts
M1019 Threat Intelligence Program — track ARTEX-linked activity

title: FIFA confirms cyberattack — Handsome Boy Hacking Club claims 12GB+ documents
sum: FIFA confirmed a cyberattack in which 'limited personal and business information' was accessed; the Handsome Boy Hacking Club claimed 12GB+ of internal documents. Investigation ongoing.
ctl: M1041 Encrypt Sensitive Information — protect member/partner PII
M1047 Audit — review access logs
M1057 Data Loss Prevention — monitor for leaked documents

title: Colorado myColorado app breach exposes ~100K users' uploaded documents
sum: Around 100K myColorado app users' uploaded documents — passports, vehicle registrations and insurance cards — were accessed; the app has been offline since the Nov 18 incident.
ctl: M1041 Encrypt Sensitive Information — protect uploaded identity documents
M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — secure access on restore
M1018 User Account Management — scope affected accounts

title: Nvidia responds to Gentlemen ransomware claim — no evidence of compromise
sum: Nvidia says there is no evidence of compromise of its own systems; the Gentlemen ransomware claim may relate to a third-party partner's systems rather than Nvidia itself.
ctl: M1019 Threat Intelligence Program — verify the claim independently
M1047 Audit — check partner-facing systems
M1053 Data Backup — confirm offline recoverability
